# nlohmann/json 3.10.5

JSON library (full header tree, `include/nlohmann/`) used to read the simulation input files
(`projects/geometric-flow/src/SimConfig.cpp`). Copied unchanged from the
Ubuntu package `nlohmann-json3-dev` (3.10.5); keep all of `include/nlohmann/`,
since `json.hpp` includes the files next to it. MIT licensed; the license is at
the top of `include/nlohmann/json.hpp`. Upstream: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
